name: דִּבְלָיִם
summary: Hosea identifies Gomer, whom he marries, as the daughter of Diblaim.

evidence.note: Diblaim is named when Hosea takes Gomer as his wife.

note: The ending resembles the Hebrew dual, and the name recalls דְּבֵלָה, a fig cake. The verse establishes Gomer’s parentage but leaves the meaning of the name open.
